findings.title: Prevent language preference recreation after deletion
findings.requirement: B11 AC1/AC3 and approved content+derived deletion policy
findings.cause: commit_language_preference locks only its own optional row, never the live owning session. A delayed preparation can insert a fresh preference after DELETE has removed the session. Cleanup only traverses extant sessions, so the orphan survives.
findings.repro: Private PG + actual HTTP: pause deterministic provider in preparation, DELETE own session (204), release provider declaring explicit_language_tag=fr. Session and preference counts at delete completion are0; late request504 creates1 language row linked to deleted SID. Explicit purge at now+8days leaves1 row.
findings.disposition: CLOSED on v2 by independent original reproducer recheck

findings.title: Serialize cleanup before copying quota reservations
findings.requirement: B11 AC2/AC3 and unchanged B10 quota accounting
findings.cause: Both cleanup paths select without exclusive session claim; concurrent cleanup transactions may copy the same recent reservation into two random redacted rows. Idempotent deletion changes hotel admission count.
findings.repro: One reserved request; two actual delete_guest_session calls in concurrent threads. SQLAlchemy after_cursor_execute barrier only schedules both recent SELECTs before DELETE. Both calls returnTrue, session count0, retained quota count2. Explicit delete can overlap scheduled cleanup after phase1 expiry.
findings.disposition: CLOSED on v2 by independent original reproducer recheck

findings.title: Resample expiry after selection scope locks before writing
findings.requirement: B11 AC1/AC3; approved max24h content/derived lifecycle; expected-results expiry_boundary denies consumer paths at/after boundary
findings.cause: select_room_advice_option samples UTC before waiting for session/hotel/result locks and reuses it to check currentness; no actual post-lock expiry check. A live request can wait across expiry and commit derived selection with a backdated timestamp.
findings.repro: Actual HTTP on privateQ with unexpired signed token. Existing valid stored result; hold hotel FORUPDATE. Selection starts live and acquires session lock then waits hotel. Advance real time across controlled expires_at, release hotel. API returns200 and selection exists although completion is after expiry.
findings.note: Not a claim of post-DELETE-completion leakage. Two prior findings remain independently closed on v2; this is the expiry lock boundary.
